items.heading: Two Genuinely Unrelated Fields Answer
items.text: Two genuinely unrelated fields answer to "information science" in India, and confusing them wastes real research time. One is an engineering branch that competes directly with Computer Science for software and data jobs. The other is a humanities-and-science field about organising and retrieving information, in libraries, archives, and increasingly corporate knowledge-management systems.

items.heading: Research Your Career Path Through
items.text: Research your career path through Computer Science career options directly, not through a separate "information science" search. The core subjects, employer pool, and pay bands closely track a Computer Science degree. Read Computer Science Career Options for the full nine-track breakdown and real pay by role.

rows: A B.E./B.Tech engineering branch (most established under VTU and other Karnataka universities), teaching largely the same core as Computer Science: programming, databases, networks, and software systems, with a lean toward information systems and data.
Software developer, data engineer, systems analyst, the same employer pool as Computer Science graduates

A separate humanities-and-science field covering how information is organised, catalogued, preserved, and retrieved, in physical libraries and increasingly in digital archives and knowledge-management systems.
Librarian, archivist, knowledge manager, digital-repository specialist, records manager
